author: cdc-rfc1-author (Claude Sonnet 5.5)
workflow_class: Gray pointer FIFO and cross-clock memory
rationale: cnt_q is a live binary counter (cnt_q + 1) whose 4 bits are individually synchronized into clk_b: CDC-017 ERROR Heuristic (Async). Reader A's no-reset note does not affect the structural label; no --deck cdc rule depends on the counter's startup value here.

author_reading.workflow_class: Gray pointer FIFO and cross-clock memory
author_reading.rationale: A live 4-bit binary counter is synchronized bit by bit across an async boundary: multiple bits change per increment.

labels.workflow_class: Gray pointer FIFO and cross-clock memory
labels.rationale: The live plus-one binary update can change several bits at once. Per-bit two-stage synchronization can deliver a mixed count to snap_q.
labels.suspected_flaw: cnt_q has no reset or initializer, so the standalone four-state model remains X from default startup.

labels.workflow_class: Gray pointer FIFO and cross-clock memory
labels.rationale: cnt_q[3:0] is a live 4-bit binary counter in clk_a (if (tick_i) cnt_q <= cnt_q + 4'd1 at design.sv:13) whose raw binary bits are synchronized directly into asynchronous domain clk_b via s1_q -> s2_q (design.sv:16-17) without Gray encoding, allowing multi-bit transitions to be sampled incoherently (CDC-017 ERROR Heuristic).
